result.topic_en: Scattered calculations with square-root relations among products of quantities p, q, ρ (sums of square roots vanishing, as in theta-function relations), a cross-ratio substitution, a small factorisation, and a derivative computation of a potential-like sum over 1/r.

methods.what: Squaring a three-term vanishing sum of square roots to eliminate radicals
Product of two linear forms expressed as difference of square-root terms
Four-term vanishing sums of square roots (theta-type relations)
Cross-ratio substitution mapping branch points to 0, 1, ∞
Factorisation of a quadratic in p
Velocity-dependent potential of charges and its time derivative
Relation among products via auxiliary quantities ρ, σ
